method: 8x8 Bayer ordered threshold with a contrast-adjusted five-color palette, tuned per photograph
paletteRelationship: The photo palette is a print palette, not the page token set: #cd6f63 echoes the chrome coral #ff6257, #f6f1e8 is the brand paper, #182733 is the deep ink the editorial frames use. The two blue-grays (#284b60, #708188) exist only in the artwork. The brand chip yellow #ffeb00 is NOT part of the photo palette; it appears in the frames as the focus outline color and in the illustrations.
perPhotoTuning: Each photo gets its own crop, contrast, brightness, and Bayer amplitude so texture stays readable; settings live in client/tools/process-dealio-editorial.py

usageStatus.photos: Six tech context photos are wired into the set: tech-desk is the dashboard greeting hero, and headphones opens the discover store front. The other four derivatives (server-rack, electronics-store, smartwatch, audio-rack) are prepared and machine verified but have no page consumer yet, so they load only if a later page wires them.
usageStatus.illustrations: The price-tag illustration is wired on the dashboard hero and the shopping-basket illustration backs the shared empty state. product-box is the fallback image for every product slot without a photo, so an imageless tile shows the drawn package instead of a brand letter. The twelve category illustrations are prepared and served but not yet wired into the discover category tiles.

licensing.shareAlike: One source photo is share-alike licensed, audio-rack under CC BY-SA 4.0. That dithered derivative is an alteration under the licence and is therefore distributed under the same terms, with attribution retained in the hidden caption and in credits.json. The other five need no share-alike: tech-desk, headphones and smartwatch are CC0, server-rack is CC BY 4.0, and electronics-store is public domain. Attribution is kept for all six.
licensing.attribution: Photos are not links, so nothing on a page navigates away when a reader clicks a photo. Attribution lives in each rendered image's hover title and in a visually hidden caption that assistive tech announces, plus credits.json. If an image fails to load, the component renders a visible fallback credit block (creator, title, license link) in its place.

illustrationConventions: Illustrations use the brand family only (coral #ff6257, chip yellow #ffeb00, paper #f6f1e8, ink #202020). Stroke ladder: 7px primary outline on every body shape, 5 to 7px detail strokes, and a 4px micro-glyph exception for tiny interior marks such as the coin cross. Price flags are rotated 8 degrees on the four new pieces only; the two pre-existing pieces (price-tag, shopping-basket) are untouched.
verification: Run the script to regenerate and machine-verify all derivatives against credits.json
